title: Mesh Micro-Rollups
tagline: Massively-forkable fully on-chain game worlds with Mesh Micro-Rollups.
description:
# Ideally On-Chain Game Should Have:
- Provable Gameplay
- Community Governance
- Immutable Ownership
- Forkability + Mods

But the current infrastructure doesn't allow this to happen because:
- Expensive Compute
- Tech Constraints
- Tick Rate
- Poor UX/DevX

## Micro Rollups

Building Micro Rollups can leverage the power of programming languages like Javascript and speed of web2 while facilitiating the verifiablitiy on-chain. Stackr protocol allows building such micro rollups that we used.

# Mesh Micro Rollups: Forkablity + Mods for On-Chain Games

It provides the features like Game Forking instanenously from user's end without going through lots of hassels in Smart Contract Forking & Chain Forking. 

Forking & Mods will allow any user to create a fork of the state on L2 and start a new state transitions for their demands. 

This is similar to authors writing fiction and cults driving the fan-fiction versions from it.
